title: PROFNIT question bank
description: The contract for data/question-bank.json. tools/validate.py implements it and the two must agree: a rule in one and not the other is a bug.

version.description: Format version. The app rejects a version it does not know.

generatedAt.description: The date the bank was built.

toolchain.description: Version of every external tool that shaped the output. pdftotext must be the poppler build.

topics.description: The taxonomy every question's topic is drawn from. A topic that no question uses is an error, and so is a question whose topic is not declared here.

id.description: Short identifier, e.g. ENA26, AV2-PI. A proper noun, never translated.

title.description: Portuguese title, displayed to the student.

date.description: The date the paper was applied.

hasOfficialAnswerKey.description: Whether a published answer key backs this paper's answers.

id.description: The slug stored in question.topic. Portuguese kebab-case, singular, unaccented.

label.description: Portuguese label, displayed. The app shows this, never the slug.

definition.description: Portuguese sentence delimiting what the topic covers.

id.description: Always <exam>-Q<NN>, and it must agree with exam and number.

exam.description: Must match the id of an entry of exams[].

number.description: The number printed on the paper. Contiguous 1..N per paper.

topic.description: The slug of an entry of topics[]. Displayed through that entry's label, never de-hyphenated.

stem.description: The question body, with its significant line breaks preserved. Holds no page header or footer residue.

options.description: The four options. Each one holds no page header or footer residue.

duplicateOf.description: Set when the paper prints this question twice. The target exists and is not itself a duplicate.

knownDefects.description: Defects of the printed paper, recorded rather than silently fixed.

excludedReason.description: Why the question must never be drawn. It still belongs to the bank, to its paper's count and to the review surface. annulled: the official key prints ANULADA instead of a letter. source-booklet-defect: the printed booklet reprints an earlier question here, so the letter the key gives this number answers a question the bank does not hold.

letter.description: The correct option. Absent only on a question that carries excludedReason, which is enforced on the question, not here.

source.description: official means a published answer key states this, and nothing else.

reference.description: What supports the answer: a file in references/ with a locator, the answer-key PDF, or a plain statement that no file in references/ supports it.

rationale.description: Portuguese argument for a derived answer's letter, which no published key states.

explanation.description: Portuguese explanation of an official answer: why the published letter is the right one. Teaching material, not provenance.
